source.priorReviewScope: historical source preparation, not current model or visual approval

reviewPlan.intent: Static deep hip-compression V-sit with both knees straight and palms supporting beside the hips.
reviewPlan.cameraReason: Side three-quarter view shows the V at the hips and distinguishes compression from leaning the entire body backward.
points: Keep the thighs near the torso without broad mesh interpenetration.
Hands and feet must be distinct and visible.
No false backward-body substitute for hip compression.
Inspect left/right wrist and foot orientation even though the hold is static.
continuousOrientation: Inspect actual local/world hand and foot quaternions across the entire sampled path and across the loop seam.
Use quaternion sign continuity and incremental shortest-arc angles; equal start/end directions do not exclude a 180/360-degree twist inside the cycle.
Compare palm/sole normals and finger/toe directions against forearm/shin direction on both sides.
Flag abrupt Euler/axis-angle branch changes for actual skeleton and image review; do not declare a defect from Euler magnitude alone.
Inspect visible wrist and ankle deformation through intermediate frames; quaternion continuity alone does not certify a natural shape.

leftHand.note: Floor wrist pose is supplied by the active hand adapter; source finger/normal checks cannot certify its wrist rotation.

rightHand.note: Floor wrist pose is supplied by the active hand adapter; source finger/normal checks cannot certify its wrist rotation.

limits: Composed source foot rotations are inspected before IK and model transforms. Actual wrist and ankle quaternions and visible deformation still need rendering.
A large Euler value or cumulative path is only a review lead, not a defect verdict.

reviewPlan.propPolicy: The existing thin support mat remains an explicit prop. Its visible extent belongs to the fixed whole-cycle content rectangle; no separate ground-shadow layer.

risks: Source fixed rootZ=0.083126 m is a settled value from the old solver, and its deep hip angles use old leg targets. Reconcile new proportions using actual palm and body surfaces without post-solve pelvis clipping.
armfix-r2 does not migrate old r5 contact calibration or P4/P5 appearance corrections automatically.
The saved support shape is an unreviewed legacy-mesh candidate; accepted dumbbell/wrist-r4 geometry is not a support-hand approval.
No new preview or full-cycle visual approval was performed while preparing this recipe.

appearance.purpose: Visual cue for target muscle effort, not a physiological measurement
